cards.description: The set's cards, in order: at-uris of cards.sunshine.card records. A card's record is only published once someone first scans it, so expect records listed here to be absent until then, and show the set gracefully when one is not found.

strings.description: The set's title and description, one entry per language. The first entry is the default, shown when none matches the reader's language.

main.description: A set of Sunshine Cards, in order, like 'Autumn Market 2026'. A set may include other accounts' cards. Listing a card exposes its record key, which today is its tag's UID.

strings.description: The set's strings in one language.
